notes.title: Now Available on Steam - BrutalAliens!
notes.notes:
BrutalAliens is Now Available on Steam. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/886600/BrutalAliens/] BrutalAliens[/url] is a game about invasion of alien space colonies, you are equipped with heavy weapons, soldiers troops and tactical skills. You have to eradicate all the alien race called Vorganoidz from the galaxy.

[b] If you enjoy the game, please make sure to leave a brief Steam Review.[/b]
